∩╗┐## [Add Post] View Post Report and Documentation

Tested by :

QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9

Project :

Panorra Mobile @lundara02

Description of Feature :

The "View Post" feature allows users to view published 360-degree panorama posts in a full immersive interactive viewer. Users can look around by dragging, browse through multi-panorama scenes, toggle motion sensors (gyroscope / compass), interact with social actions (like, comment, bookmark, share), and swipe up for detailed place metadata.

Device :

  • Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F) Android 14 (One UI 6.1)

📋 QA Regression & Smoke Test Report March 2026

📱 Test Environment

Parameter Details
Device Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F)
OS Version Android 14 (One UI 6.1)
App Build Panorra Mobile v1.2.0 (Expo SDK 54 / React Native)
Tester Account estergothru@gmail.com (Real User Account)
Test Date 03 March 2026
Test Scope Full 360 Viewer, Sphere Pan/Tilt, Multi-panorama Switching, Sensor Modes & Social Controls

🔍 Code Review & Architectural Inspection

  • Component Under Test: src/pages/place/screens/post-detail/ & Panorama viewer engine.
  • Interactive Gestures: Full 360 degree pan and pitch handling with responsive touch drag.
  • Multi-Scene Navigation: Scene carousel at bottom allows switching between panorama items (1/2, 2/2) with synchronized indicator updates.
  • Sensor Integration: Motion sensor hook correctly maps device gyroscope and compass to camera orientation when enabled.
  • Social & Metadata Layer: Author badge, views counter, like/comment counts, and details sheet render cleanly over the WebGL canvas.
